summary: Describes how version 2 of the Internet network management framework can live alongside the original SNMPv1 framework. It addresses how the two can work together during the transition. It was replaced by RFC 2576.

eli5.summary: When a new language comes along, people who speak the old one still need to talk to people who speak the new one. This note explains how to make both work together.

questions: how do snmpv1 and snmpv2 coexist
how to migrate from snmpv1 to snmpv2
